title: Tournaments | Kaderblick Docs

hero.heading: Tournaments
hero.lead: A tournament is created as a Kaderblick calendar event. Configure its match mode and fixtures there; the tournament view then combines teams, matches, results and match access.

body:
Create a tournament

  1. Open Calendar and select New event.
  2. Enter title, date and time and choose Tournament as the event type.
  3. If required, set end date, end time, response and personal reminders.
  4. Select Next to edit tournament configuration and fixtures.

Details and configuration

The second step provides location, tournament type, match duration, break, match mode, meeting point and meeting time. In the verified interface, Indoor tournament (1 pitch) is preselected and Round robin is offered as the mode.

Build fixtures

  • Generate automatically: creates the schedule from the current configuration.
  • Create manually: adds one specific fixture.
  • Import (CSV/JSON): imports a prepared schedule from a file.
  • Clear list: removes the current fixture list from the draft.

After details, the wizard contains Fixtures and Description. Review the schedule completely before saving the calendar event.

Tournament view

Open a saved tournament through its calendar or match connection; there is no separate tournament list in the main menu. Details show:

  • status, date and time, fixture and team counts, location and weather access,
  • settings such as half duration, match mode, type and group count,
  • a PDF action for the schedule,
  • all participating teams with your own teams marked,
  • fixtures grouped by tournament phase with live, planned or finished status, score, round, location and kick-off.

Open a fixture

If a fixture already has an associated Kaderblick match, its card opens full match details with events, videos, timings and match plan according to permission.

Visibility by role and relationship

  • Users assigned to a team: initially see their teams’ fixtures and can expand to all tournament matches.
  • Users without a matching team: receive tournament information without a personalised own-team selection.
  • Authorised appointment managers: create the tournament in Calendar and manage configuration and fixtures there.
